# Chudleigh Health Hub (Health Autonomy)

> Osteopathy, physiotherapy and longevity assessments at 90 Fore Street, Chudleigh, Devon TQ13 0HT, UK. Registered osteopaths (General Osteopathic Council) and an HCPC-registered physiotherapist. Seeing patients from Chudleigh, Bovey Tracey, Newton Abbot, Kingsteignton, Teignmouth, Exeter and the Teign Valley.

## Key facts
- Phone: 07902 065739 (WhatsApp available). Email: info@chudleighhealth.com
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm, with out-of-hours appointments available
- Book online: https://book.squareup.com/appointments/z4iykwnki8iox0/location/LNR036HT1VD7Y/services
- Fees: new patient osteopathy consultation £85; follow-up £50; physiotherapy initial assessment £85, follow-up £50; longevity assessment packages £150, £375 and £595; Rebalance and Bloom mum and baby package £165; return to sport / performance test (force plates, about 45 minutes, written report) £95; club testing days from £30 per player (about 15 minutes each, minimum 8 players; at the clinic, or at the club for squads of 15+); force plate testing during treatment is included in normal appointment fees
- No GP referral needed. Many health insurers cover osteopathy.
- Team: John Evans (osteopath and longevity coach, GOsC 6171, Area Leader for osteopathy at Plymouth Marjon University), Steph Evans (osteopath, GOsC 6208, treats all ages with special interests in babies, children, pregnancy and postnatal care; Programme Leader for the Irish College of Osteopathic Medicine BSc at Plymouth Marjon University), Will Mintram (osteopath, GOsC 10818, lecturer at Plymouth Marjon University), and Dan Feasey (physiotherapist, HCPC PH141113; formerly a sports therapist at Torquay United and Exeter City and a physiotherapist with Exeter Chiefs, with a special interest in sports injuries and rehabilitation)
- What makes the clinic different: progress is measured, not guessed. Strength, balance and movement are measured at the start and re-tested at review, using the same kind of force plates professional sports teams use.
- Treats: lower back pain and sciatica, neck pain and headaches arising from the neck, shoulder pain including frozen shoulder, tennis and golfer's elbow, hip and knee pain including arthritic pain, sports injuries, pregnancy and postnatal aches, and offers gentle osteopathy for babies
- Longevity and performance assessment (Health Autonomy): one 45-minute, needle-free appointment with six tests: body composition (Tanita MC-780MA), skin autofluorescence (AGE Reader), 12-lead ECG, heart rate variability (Frontier X2), spirometry and SpO2, and VALD ForceDecks force plates, plus a calculated VO2 max, with a same-day traffic-light report
- Assessment packages: The Longevity Baseline £150; The 60-Day Programme £375 (adds a goal-setting consultation, bespoke 60-day plan and 8-week retest); The Complete Overhaul £595 (adds four 45-minute clinical sessions)

## Guides and FAQs
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/faq.html): GP referrals, prices, first appointments, insurance, parking, opening hours, longevity assessments and booking at Chudleigh Health Hub.
- [What is an AGE Reader scan?](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/age-reader-scan.html): How the skin autofluorescence scan measures advanced glycation end-products (AGEs), what the BodyAge result means and how to prepare.
- [Osteopath or physiotherapist for a sports injury?](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/osteopath-or-physio-sports-injury.html): How osteopaths and physiotherapists differ, which might suit you, and when to seek urgent help.
- [Lower back pain from sitting at a desk](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/desk-back-pain.html): Practical tips for desk-related back pain, when to see an osteopath and urgent warning signs.
- [What is PEMF therapy?](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/pemf-therapy.html): What pulsed electromagnetic field therapy is, what a session feels like, what the research says and who should not have it.
- [Red and near-infrared light therapy](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/red-light-therapy.html): What photobiomodulation is, how a session works, what the research says and who should avoid it.
- [What a 12-lead ECG tells you before you start training](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/ecg-test.html): What a resting ECG measures and why it is used as a baseline for exercise planning, not a diagnosis.
- [Force plate testing: measuring your power and balance](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/force-plate-testing.html): How VALD ForceDecks measure peak power and left/right asymmetry, for healthy ageing and athletes.
- [Tanita body composition analysis](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/tanita-body-composition.html): What the Tanita MC-780MA segmental analyser measures: limb muscle, visceral fat, body water, phase angle and metabolic age.
- [Spirometry: lung function and lung age](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/spirometry-lung-test.html): What FVC, FEV1, lung age and SpO2 mean and how to prepare for the test.
- [The Health Autonomy Journal](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/health-autonomy/journal.html): Osteopath John Evans tracks his own Health Autonomy results (VO2 max, BodyAge, body composition, heart, lungs, power, steps) retest by retest, with monthly updates.
- [Sample Health Autonomy report](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/health-autonomy/sample-report.html): John Evans's own full Health Autonomy assessment report from 26 October 2026, shown as an example of what participants receive.
- [Patient stories](https://www.chudleighhealth.com/stories.html): Patient experiences shared with written permission, and how to share your own.
